integrity: The six-edge relative Jacobian scheme and splitting-field calculation are proved symbolically. Finite-field enumeration is a consistency check, not an infinite proof. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed prior results.
scientific_limitations: Over characteristic two with all four diagonal quadratic coefficients nonzero; no classification of boundary vertices, projective isomorphism classes, or Picard lattices. Generic monodromy refers to the marked ten-parameter coefficient function field.
title: Tetrahedral quartic singular schemes and six independent Artin–Schreier pairs
